name: mcp-cash-book
description: One double-entry ledger derived from your invoices, bank, expenses, deposits and assets.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: ledger_build
tools.description: Derive the double-entry ledger for one period in ONE currency from the invoice, credit note, deposit, expense, bank and asset stores, and register it. Nothing is written back. Free: 3 periods a month.

tools.name: period_delete
tools.description: Delete one built period from the register and give its free-tier slot back. Refused when a closed month's snapshot covers the period, and that month is named. No sibling book is touched.

tools.name: trial_balance
tools.description: Total the debits and the credits for a period and prove they are equal to the minor unit. When they are not, name the entries whose own legs do not add up and the source document behind each. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: ledger_lines
tools.description: List the ledger lines for a period, filtered by account, source server, source_id or date; each carries its debit, credit and bank_ref, with the totals of the rows returned. Filtered totals do not balance. Free.

tools.name: month_close
tools.description: List what a month leaves unposted or unbalanced, with its trial balance and bank reconciliation, then store the close as a snapshot; a later call names any drift against it. dry_run writes nothing. Pro.

tools.name: ledger_export_csv
tools.description: Return the period's ledger lines as RFC 4180 CSV, one row per leg including bank_ref. No file is written. Pro, but ledger_lines returns these same fields free and unlimited; this only lays them out as CSV columns.

tools.name: ledger_report
tools.description: Report a built period account by account: debits, credits, movement and closing balance, plus purchase commitments held as memos and the period's exceptions. Pro; ledger_lines gives the lines free.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.
